issues.message: The workbook reports BMI >=28 kg/m2, while the article specifies BMI >=25.0 kg/m2.
issues.action: Replace the BMI criterion with separate > and = operator cells and value 25.0.

issues.message: The article's liver-function, eGFR, secondary-obesity, and weight-altering medication exclusions are not fully represented.
issues.action: Add each exclusion as an independent criterion with atomic threshold fields.

issues.message: Chinese recruitment was converted into unsupported 100% Asian arm-level baseline records.
issues.action: Delete the fabricated rows; nationality and recruitment setting do not prove race distribution.

issues.message: The primary gout-flare result is absent or conflicts with 11/28 placebo versus 5/35 orlistat.
issues.action: Extract the primary arm results and link the single HR/log-rank comparison.

issues.message: Most Table 2 secondary efficacy endpoints are missing.
issues.action: Extract every arm-specific Table 2 endpoint with its dispersion and one linked p-value.

issues.message: The main article reports oil spots and mild diarrhea, but the workbook does not contain them.
issues.action: Add every main-article adverse event and retain Supplementary Table S1 as an open review item.

limitations: A structural pass is not proof of scientific correctness.
For an unseen trial, scientific correction requires a source-grounded truth bundle or independent human/AI adjudication.
PRISMA compliance is assessed at systematic-review level, not as a property of a single RCT extraction.
